impact.title: Error budget impact
impact.policyOn: The team's policy holds this application to {{threshold}} % of an SLO's budget for one incident.
impact.policyOff: The policy is off. Keigan shows the budget impact but holds nobody to it.
impact.emptyDescription: No SLO of this application watches the services this incident affected, so there is no budget figure.
impact.notEnoughData: Not enough measurements in the window ({{coverage}} % measured, at least {{minimum}} % needed).
impact.overlapNote: Overlapping incidents each count the minutes they share, so shares are not added together. The figure is provisional until a day after resolution, while late measurements may still arrive.

policy.title: Error budget policy
policy.description: What the team agreed to do when reliability costs too much. Keigan holds the application to it, inside Keigan only: it never blocks a deployment or changes a customer system.
policy.holdUs: Keigan holds this application to the policy
policy.offHelp: Off: Keigan shows the budget impact on incidents but holds nobody to it.
policy.classThreshold: One kind of outage may use
policy.classWindow: Window for a kind of outage
policy.windowHint: Days. Default {{default}}, at most {{maximum}} (the SLI history Keigan keeps)
policy.guidance: What we do when an SLO's budget is used up
policy.guidanceHelp: Shown on the SLO page and in the email when a budget is used up. At most {{maximum}} characters.
policy.guidancePlaceholder: For example: pause feature releases except urgent and security fixes until the SLO is met again.
policy.sentenceOn: If one incident uses more than {{threshold}} % of an SLO's budget, Keigan drafts a postmortem and needs an accepted top-priority 'prevent' action item before it can be finalised. If one kind of outage uses more than the limit over {{window}} days, a top-priority item is needed too.
policy.sentenceOff: Off. Turn it on once the team has agreed to it.

banner.met: This incident used {{share}} % of the {{sli}} budget (limit {{threshold}} %). The postmortem has the action item the policy asks for.
banner.provisional: This incident used {{share}} % of the {{sli}} budget (limit {{threshold}} %). The figure becomes final a day after resolution; nothing is required until then.
banner.open: This incident used {{share}} % of the {{sli}} budget (limit {{threshold}} %). Finalising needs at least one accepted top-priority 'prevent' action item.

waive.title: Waive the policy requirement
waive.description: The postmortem can then be finalised without the top-priority item. Your name and reason are recorded and shown on the postmortem.
waive.reasonHelp: Say why, for example that the measurement was wrong or the risk was accepted.

exhausted.title: Budget used up: {{sli}} ({{application}})
exhausted.noResponse: No agreed response is written yet. An application admin can add one in the policy card on the SLO step of the application.
